T: Eat at the long table. Wear the flowers.
D: A grieving young woman travels to a remote Swedish commune for a midsummer festival that turns sinister.
P: Serve the feast when Dani is crowned May Queen and the table toasts her.
S: May Queen's lucky herring and new potatoes
Pickled herring with dill new potatoes, sour cream, chives and red onion

Small new potatoes boiled with dill, served warm with pickled herring, sour cream, chives and red onion. Boil 600g new potatoes with dill until tender. Serve warm with 250g pickled herring, a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.
Radish, cucumber and carrot ring with edible flowers and a dill sour cream dip

Radishes, cucumber, baby carrots and edible flowers arranged in a ring like a crown, with a herby dill and sour cream dip. Arrange radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter, tucking edible flowers between them like a crown. Mix 200g sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.
Midsummer aged cheese tart with dill cream
the long tables in the sun

A crisp shortcrust tart of aged cheddar and parmesan custard baked until just set, served in wedges with dill sour cream and salmon roe. Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23cm tart tin with a sheet of shortcrust pastry, prick, line with paper and weights and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml cream and plenty of pepper, then stir in 150g grated aged cheddar and 50g parmesan. Pour into the shell and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Mix 150ml sour cream with chopped dill. Serve wedges warm with the dill cream and a spoon of salmon roe.
M: Salmon cured 48 hours in salt, sugar and dill, with mustard sauce

Salmon cured 48 hours in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced thin, with a sweet mustard and dill sauce and rye bread. Cover a 600g salmon fillet with 50g salt, 50g sugar, chopped dill and white pepper. Weight and cure in the fridge for 48 hours. Slice thin. Mix 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp sugar, vinegar and oil with dill for sauce. Serve with rye bread.
Hårga open-fire lamb with dill potatoes
Grilled over coals. Ignore the bear.

Butterflied lamb leg marinated in garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled over coals and sliced pink, with buttery dill new potatoes and a mustard herb sauce. Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg in 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt for 2 hours. Grill over medium-hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes a side until 58C inside, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg new potatoes until tender and toss with 50g butter and chopped dill. Whisk 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 80ml oil and chopped parsley for the sauce. Slice the lamb and serve.
W: Sponge layers filled with custard, whipped cream and strawberries

Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, split into three, each layer brushed with milk, filled with vanilla custard, whipped cream and sliced strawberries, whole berries on top.
K: Crushed strawberries with gin and elderflower cordial, served pale and cold

Gin, elderflower cordial, lemon and crushed strawberries topped with sparkling water, served pale pink over ice with edible flowers floating on top. Crush 250g hulled strawberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar in a jug and leave 15 minutes. Add 200ml gin, 100ml elderflower cordial and the juice of 2 lemons and stir. Fill the jug with ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling water. Pour into glasses with a few edible flowers on top. Leave out the gin for a booze-free jug.

veg.n: Pelle's pickled eggplant and new potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the eggplant up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into finger strips, toss with the oil and roast at 220C for 20 minutes until soft.
Warm the vinegar, water, sugar and allspice until the sugar dissolves. Pour over the hot eggplant with half the red onion and leave to pickle for 1 hour.
Boil the potatoes with the dill until tender.
Serve the potatoes warm with the drained eggplant, a bowl of sour cream with chives and the rest of the red onion.
Arrange the radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter.
Tuck edible flowers between them like a crown.
Mix the sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.

dishes.make_ahead: Needs 48 hours curing, keeps 4 days chilled

ingredients.item: caster sugar, 50g for the cure and the rest for the sauce

steps.text: Mix the salt, most of the sugar, chopped dill and white pepper and pack over the salmon.
Weight the salmon and cure in the fridge for 48 hours.
Wipe off the cure and slice thin.
Mix the Dijon, remaining sugar, vinegar, oil and dill for the sauce. Serve with rye bread.

veg.make_ahead: Needs 24 hours marinating, keeps 4 days chilled

ingredients.item: caster sugar, 30g for the cure and the rest for the sauce

steps.text: Bury the whole carrots in the rock salt in a baking dish and bake at 190C until tender.
Crack off the salt, peel the carrots and slice into long thin ribbons with a peeler.
Toss the ribbons with 2 tbsp of the oil, 1 tbsp of the vinegar, 30g of the sugar, half the chopped dill and the white pepper. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 24 hours.
Mix the Dijon, remaining sugar, vinegar, oil and dill for the sauce. Serve with rye bread.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar until thick and fold in the flour.
Bake at 175C for 25 minutes, then cool completely.
Split the sponge into three and brush each layer with milk.
Fill with custard, whipped cream and sliced strawberries.
Top with whole berries.
